meta.title: About us · {{brand:name}}
meta.description: A local-first studio for Tamil and Indian filmmakers, from idea to call sheet: write the story and the screenplay, plan the shoot, all saved in your own browser first.

hero.h1: A studio for Tamil and Indian filmmakers, from idea to call sheet
hero.sub: {{brand:name}} is a working desk for screenwriting, pre-production and craft study, built to run in your browser and keep your work on your own device first.

body: A film moves through many hands and many files before the first shoot day: a story, a screenplay, a breakdown, a schedule, a budget, a call sheet. We built one place where each of those reads the same scenes, so a change in the script reaches the plan.

It starts from how films here are made: dialogue in Tamil, Tanglish or English, a budget in rupees that starts from dated Chennai rates, and a reference library of films, directors and the rules of the craft.

who.body: Independent and first-time filmmakers, screenwriters and small crews: indie directors, writers and line producers who want the script and the plan in one place.

items.title: Story
items.text: Place your beats on one of eleven story structures, keep a story bible of characters, conflict, stakes, theme and world, and park ideas in the Idea Vault.

items.title: Screenplay
items.text: A screenplay writer for Tamil, Tanglish and English. The format sets itself as you type, drafts are numbered, and Fountain, Final Draft and PDF scripts can be brought in.

items.title: Pre-production tools
items.text: Breakdown, shot list, storyboard, stripboard, budget, cast and crew, sides and call sheets, all read from one scene list.

items.title: Library
items.text: Films, director archetypes, rules of thumb, the craft books, equipment and rate tables, and a watch list, to study while you work.

items.title: Your work is saved in your own browser first
items.text: Every keystroke is written to your device first. We do not claim ownership of anything you write here.

items.title: It works offline
items.text: The studio installs like an app and keeps working without a connection. It works on set without a signal for up to 14 days after you last signed in on that device.

items.title: Sync and backup when you want them
items.text: You enter the studio by signing in with Google. Syncing your films between devices comes with a studio membership, and a backup to your own Google Drive is there if you switch it on.

items.title: Nothing you write is deleted
items.text: If a part of the studio is closed to your plan, what you wrote in it stays and reappears when your plan includes it. You can download your work at any time: the screenplay as PDF, Word, Final Draft or Fountain, the breakdown, shot list and budget as CSV, and every project in one backup file.

items.title: Yearly plans, one payment
items.text: A plan is one year for one payment. Checkout shows the currency and the exact amount you will be charged before you pay. Nothing renews by itself, so there is nothing to cancel.
